original_snippet:
if user_id != doc.owner_id and user_id not in doc.shared_with:
        raise UnauthorizedError(f"User {user_id} cannot edit doc {doc.id}")
description: Remove the ownership/shared-with guard from edit_document
expected_violation: An unauthorized third party edits a document they neither own nor are shared on
violation_scenario: edit_document('intruder', Document(id='d1', owner_id='user1', content='old'), 'hacked') sets content to 'hacked' and raises nothing.
rationale: Deleting the two guard lines is the smallest plausible change that lets an unauthorized user edit a document.
